tooltip.alienisolation.flashlight: Use: toggle. Light makes you visible.
tooltip.alienisolation.tracker: Hold: shows movement ahead. The alien can hear it beep when close.
tooltip.alienisolation.flamethrower: Hold use: spray fire. Scares the alien off, but it learns.
tooltip.alienisolation.noisemaker: Throw: its beeping lures the alien.
tooltip.alienisolation.flare: Throw: bright light for 30 s. Draws some attention.
tooltip.alienisolation.station_core: Use: builds a full Sevastopol section around you and releases the alien.
tooltip.alienisolation.station_core2: Warning: replaces surrounding blocks! Use in a flat world.
message.alienisolation.saved: Game saved. You will respawn here.
message.alienisolation.help: [Sevastopol] Move slowly and crouch. Running carries far. Hide in lockers (SHIFT = hold breath, SPACE = leave). Use the motion tracker. Fire is the only thing it fears.
terminal.alienisolation.log.0: Noises in the vents. Maintenance says "rats". Rats aren't that big.
terminal.alienisolation.log.1: Waits sealed this section. Nobody in, nobody out.
terminal.alienisolation.log.2: Charged the motion tracker. If the beeping gets closer, don't run. Hide.
terminal.alienisolation.log.3: Hold your breath inside the lockers. It sniffs, it listens. It is patient.
terminal.alienisolation.log.4: It is afraid of fire. A little less every time.
terminal.alienisolation.log.5: Stay away from the ceiling grates. Something came down and took Henry.
terminal.alienisolation.log.6: When the lights flicker it's close. Turn your flashlight off.
terminal.alienisolation.log.7: Noisemakers work... for a while. Then it figures it out.
terminal.alienisolation.log.8: The Seegson synthetics won't help. Don't trust them.
terminal.alienisolation.log.9: The emergency phones still work. Watch your back while you use them.
terminal.alienisolation.log.10: We picked up the Torrens. Rescue in 48 hours. Hold on.
terminal.alienisolation.log.11: Crouch. Don't run. If you run, it hears you.
terminal.alienisolation.log.12: Someone called Ripley was asking around. Looking for her daughter...
terminal.alienisolation.log.13: Sevastopol Log 14: Lab A access restricted. Specimen missing.
